title: Multi-Currency और Forex Gain/Loss
intro:
भाग 5 — Management Features

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🟠 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

विदेशी मुद्रा में Sale/Purchase और Exchange Rate के अंतर से Forex Gain/Loss निकालना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

F11: Maintain Multi-Currency = Yes

Currency Create करें और Rate of Exchange भरें

Receipt/Payment पर वास्तविक Rate से Forex Gain/Loss अपने-आप

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Rate प्रति ₹ बनाम प्रति Foreign Currency का भ्रम

Year-end पर Closing Rate न बदलना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

F11 में 'Multi-Currency' Enable करें, ज़रूरी Currency बनाएँ और उनकी Rate of Exchange (Std./Selling/Buying) भरें। Payment/Receipt के समय अलग Exchange Rate से अपने आप Forex Gain/Loss निकलता है। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Foreign Currencies with Rate of Exchange in Tally Prime, pass the Sale/Purchase and Receipt/Payment Vouchers, and check the Forex Gain/Loss and Net Profit/Loss.
guide:
Multi-Currency और Forex Gain/Loss

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Multi-Currency की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Multi-Currency = Yes।
  • Gateway → Create → Currency: Symbol ($, £, ¥, €), Formal Name, Decimals बनाएँ।
  • Rates of Exchange भरें: Standard Rate और Selling/Buying Rate (₹ प्रति 1 Foreign Currency)।
  • Sales Voucher में Party का Currency चुनें और Exchange Rate डालें (Export में Selling Rate, Import में Buying Rate)।
  • Receipt/Payment के दिन असली Exchange Rate डालें — Forex Gain/Loss अपने-आप बनता है।
  • Forex Gain/Loss Ledger P&L में जाता है।
याद रखें

Receivable (लेना): भुगतान के दिन Rate ज़्यादा → Forex Gain; कम → Loss।

Payable (देना): भुगतान के दिन Rate ज़्यादा → Forex Loss; कम → Gain।

Rate हमेशा ₹ प्रति 1 Foreign Currency मानें (Rate per ₹ का भ्रम न करें)।
outro:

problems.title: Simple Export Sale — Single Currency (Warm-up)
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Sold goods to a US customer for $1,000 at the exchange rate of ₹75/$ (Invoice Value = ₹75,000)
  • 30th April — Received full payment of $1,000 from the customer; the exchange rate on this date is ₹76/$
problems.hint:
• 1 Apr: Sales — US Customer, $1,000 @ ₹75/$ = ₹75,000।
  • 30 Apr: Receipt — $1,000 @ ₹76/$ = ₹76,000; Forex Gain ₹1,000 (Tally अपने-आप बनाएगा)।

problems.title: Footwear Exporter — Two Foreign Sales (USD  &  GBP)
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

Exchange Rate as on 1st November — Std./Selling: $ 73.50/73.20; £ 93.90/94.10 (Rate per Rs.). Selling Price — Reebok Shoes $26/Pair, £22/Pair; Relaxo Sandal $9/Pair, £7/Pair; Action Shoes $31/Pair, £26/Pair.

Opening Stock (1st April, FY): Reebok Shoes 120 Pair @ ₹1,200; Relaxo Sandal 100 Pair @ ₹300; Action Shoes 120 Pair @ ₹1,500

  • 1st November — Sold to Thomas Edison, US (Invoice-1): 20 Pair Reebok Shoes — Total Invoice $520
  • 1st November — Sold to George, UK (Invoice-2): 20 Pair Relaxo Sandal + 10 Pair Action Shoes — Total Invoice £400
  • 1st December — Received full payment of $520 from Thomas at ₹74.10/$
  • 1st December — Received full payment of £400 from George at ₹93.95/£
problems.hint:
• Currencies: $ (Std 73.50, Selling 73.20) और £ (Std 93.90, Selling 94.10) — Date 1 Nov।
  • Opening Stock (1 Apr): Reebok Shoes 120 @ 1,200; Relaxo Sandal 100 @ 300; Action Shoes 120 @ 1,500।
  • 1 Nov: Invoice-1 Thomas Edison (US): Reebok 20 Pair × $26 = $520 (Rate = Selling 73.20)।
  • 1 Nov: Invoice-2 George (UK): Relaxo 20 × £7 + Action 10 × £26 = £400 (Rate = Selling 94.10)।
  • 1 Dec: Receipts — Thomas $520 @ 74.10; George £400 @ 93.95।

problems.title: Electronics Importer — Two Foreign Purchases (Yen  &  Euro)
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Exchange Rate as on 1st December — Std./Buying: ¥ 0.65/0.75 (Rate per Rs.); € 83.40/83.40 (Rate per Rs.). Purchase Price — Samsung LED 32-inch ¥35,200/Pcs, €424/Pcs; Samsung LED 43-inch ¥42,120/Pcs, €508/Pcs.

  • 1st December — Purchased from Chin Yun Enterprises, Japan (Invoice-1): 20 Pcs Samsung LED 32-inch — Total Invoice ¥7,04,000
  • 1st December — Purchased from Bela Enterprises, France (Invoice-2): 20 Pcs Samsung LED 43-inch — Total Invoice €10,160
  • 1st January — Paid full amount ¥7,04,000 to Chin Yun Enterprises at ₹0.80/¥
  • 1st January — Paid full amount €10,160 to Bela Enterprises at ₹83.25/€

  • 1 Dec: Purchase-2 Bela Enterprises (France): 20 Pcs LED 43-inch × €508 = €10,160 (Rate = Buying 83.40)।
  • 1 Jan: Payment — Chin Yun ¥7,04,000 @ 0.80; Bela €10,160 @ 83.25।

problems.title: Import Purchase और Year-End Unrealised Forex
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

  • 1st March — Purchased goods from a US Supplier $500 at ₹83/$; Payment बाकी
  • 31st March (Year End) — Closing Rate ₹ 84/$
  • 10th April (Next Year) — Paid $500 at ₹ 83.50/$
problems.hint:
• 1 Mar: Purchase — US Supplier $500 @ ₹83 = ₹41,500; भुगतान बाकी।
  • 31 Mar (Year End): Closing Rate ₹84 → Payable = 500 × 84 = ₹42,000। Unrealised Forex Loss = ₹500।
  • 10 Apr (अगला साल): Payment $500 @ ₹83.50 = ₹41,750। Payable ₹42,000 के मुकाबले ₹250 का Gain।
